title: Classic Beef Stew
description: Slow-simmered chuck roast with potatoes, carrots and mushrooms in a rich broth.
steps: Brown the beef in batches, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, add the broth, tomato paste and herbs, and return the beef.
Simmer covered for 2-2.5 hours, adding the potatoes, carrots and mushrooms in the last 45 minutes.
notes: This freezes and reheats better the next day — a good one to batch-cook on a weekend.
